articles.title: From Oval Office Clash to Patriot Missile Pact: Trump and Zelenskyy's Surprising Turn
articles.summary: After a public blowup last year, Trump and Zelenskyy held a "good meeting" at the White House, discussing joint production of Patriot missiles in Ukraine. The cooperation signals a major shift in U.S.-Ukraine relations.

articles.title: FIFA's Private Equity Pitch Sparks UEFA Fury: 'The Soul of Football Is Not for Sale'
articles.summary: FIFA's plan to seek private investment in a new commercial subsidiary has drawn a blistering response from UEFA, which warns it "crosses a line." The investor group is expected to be led by a firm founded by Joshua Kushner.

articles.title: Leaked Biden Tapes: Classified Info and Memory Lapses Surface from Pre-Presidency Interviews
articles.summary: Audio recordings from 2016–2017 reveal Joe Biden discussing classified material with his ghostwriter and occasionally struggling to recall details. The tapes were released by a conservative group after a legal battle.
